declarations.docstring: The auxiliary object property is preserved when the object is replaced by an isomorphic one.
Establishes the auxiliary property for a finite biproduct built with positive multiplicities of projective summands.
Forms the finite biproduct obtained by repeating each member of a family according to a natural-number multiplicity.
An auxiliary definition associated with the enclosing multiplicity-indexed biproduct construction.
A second auxiliary definition associated with the enclosing multiplicity-indexed biproduct construction.
Classifies objects with the auxiliary property by positive multiplicities of a complete family of indecomposable projectives.
Characterizes the auxiliary property by the existence of positive multiplicities in a complete family of indecomposable projectives.
